fixes.explanation: You got it, baker. Pharaoh has just said that the day Moses sees his face again, he will die. Moses answers, "As you say… I will never see your face again." (Exodus 10:29) He agrees with Pharaoh, plain and simple. I think that's a heavy way for this scene to end.

problems.problem: The passage does not say the meeting is over. Exodus 11:4–8 records Moses continuing to speak to Pharaoh.
